title: Fwd: 5 DAYS LEFT - 2026 Fall Rec Soccer Registration is OPEN - Early Bird Price Ends June 30th
description: ﻿ Team, Very few have signed up for the fall (7 so far) If you are intending to continue please sign up and let me know. If we can’t field a team we will be combining with another team. “Return to team” ends on 6/30. I really want to see this team continue. Please register. Emilie Begin forwarded message: From: Arlington Soccer Association <no-reply@ottosportmail.ai> Date: June 25, 2026 at 9:34:42 AM EDT To: exb198@yahoo.com Subject: 5 DAYS LEFT - 2026 Fall Rec Soccer Registration is OPEN - Early Bird Price Ends June 30th Reply-To: info@arlingtonsoccer.com ﻿ 5 DAY LEFT - 2026 FALL REC SOCCER REGISTRATION IS OPEN! EARLY BIRD PRICE ENDS JUNE 30th PLEASE NOTE: If you have already registered for the 2026 Fall Rec Soccer Season, pass this information along to your friends to join in the fun. IMPORTANT DATES: June 30th - Early Bird Price Ends $155 per player (plus additional county fees) July 1st - Regular Price Starts $165 per player (plus additional county fees) August 1st - Regular Price Ends and Waitlist Begins $175 per player (plus additional county fees) Ages: Kindergarten - High School Open to: Boys and Girls Practices: 1x practice per week (some older teams may choose two) Games: 1x game per week Fall Season: September - November With neighborhood-based teams, volunteer coaches, weekly practices and games, and guaranteed playing time, Rec Soccer is a fun and supportive way for kids to stay active, build friendships, and develop their love for the game.
